gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Loose, hand-drawn energy up top. Gabarito opens its terminals wide, while Zen Kaku Gothic New follows in sans-serif curves with no hairlines or swells, keeping the page easy to follow.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Expressive Gabarito leads with terminals cut open so its counters flow outward, giving the headline a distinctive hand. And Zen Maru Gothic, a plain sans, never snags on a closed bowl, so reading feels like following a single thread.
gen-gf-gabarito-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans reads like a technical manual with a friendly face, every bowl given a wide channel. Over a long passage it stays approachable, while Gabarito's rope-thin outline heading, with no thick or thin parts, adds the flourish.
gen-gf-gabarito-zilla-slab: Gabarito's bold-looking and light-looking strokes never mix within a single word, which makes the heading feel hand-drawn yet consistent. And Zilla Slab, the slab-serif body, keeps a longer passage sturdy, its broad openings on every bowl-ended curve helping the eye move along.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-amulya: Amulya is a contemporary plain sans whose curves keep generous gaps, quietly modern under the heading. And Goldman earns its keep big and short, where its widely set letters and round, parenthesis-like forms can stretch out.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-chillax: Wide, confident letters meet loose, easy ones. And Chillax, a sans drawn like spaghetti with unfinished loops, relaxes the page beneath Goldman's high lowercase and commanding presence.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-plein: Goldman stands out for its widely set letters and parenthesis-like round forms, with a big lowercase beside its capitals. Plein, a reliable sans-serif, gives each round letter a clear channel in, and that clean reliability is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-roundo: Geometric Roundo uses a lowercase n whose arch and stem match, with no thin hairline set against a thick stem anywhere in sight. A longer passage stays unclogged.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans, a plain sans, offers wide gaps between curve ends and stems, with every vertical and horizontal stroke identical in weight. But Goldman is the one to lean on for bold, commanding display, its widely set letters thriving where text stays quiet.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-synonym: Goldman's widely set letters and round, parenthesis-like forms give it a bold, commanding stance, with a big lowercase against its capitals. Synonym, a sans drawn with a ruler-like constant line, does the quieter job of reading cleanly and dependably, its curves generously open.
